notes.title: Announcement of Regularly Updated Maintenance (Server 14) 20250923
notes.notes:
Dear Players:

We will conduct a maintenance update[b] from 10:00 to 12:00 am on September 23, 2025, Beijing time[/b]. The specific maintenance progress will be advanced or postponed depending on the maintenance progress. Thanks for your understanding. During this period, the game will be inaccessible and we are sorry for the inconvenience caused.

[b][Updates][/b]

Dear Players:

We are excited to announce that the brand-new server [b][Server 13] [/b]will officially launch on [b]June 11, 2025 at 10:00 (UTC+8, Beijing Time)![/b]

We warmly welcome all players to join the new battlefield and embark on a fresh adventure!

To celebrate the launch, we've prepared a variety of special launch events and a gift code for all adventurers setting sail with us:

Server 13 Gift Code: [b]xq13[/b]

Includes:
[u]Epic Gem*10
Silver*10,000
Festival Pack*2
Tower Ticket*5
Fire Opal*1[/u]

Please note:
1.Each account can only redeem the code once.
2.Valid redemption period: [b]From server launch on June 11, 2025 until 00:00 on June 25, 2025 (UTC+8).[/b]

We look forward to seeing you in Server 13!

The following are the main contents of the new server:

[b][Event][/b]

[b]1.Supremacy: Gork Irongut
2.Buy Points, Get Rewards: 8000 - Blood Lord Pierre (Legendary) / 30000 - Blood Lord Pierre (Godlike)
3.Recharge Rebate: Sky Wedge Bufu (Epic) / Silver*100,000 / Crystal Gift Pack*2 / Dark Champion Potion*2 / Master’s Skill Pack III*2
4.Ruby Storm: Ruby*1000 / Human Card Box*1 / Silver*10,000
5.Event of Horsehair
6.Value Rebates
7.Secrets of the Tarot (The Sun)
8.Gold Rush (Weekly Event)[/b]
[u]Consume 100 gold coins: Tower Ticket*3, Silver*10,000, Bread Fragment*10
Consume 500 gold coins: Starlight Chest (Epic)*1, Crystal Gift Pack*2, Bread Fragment*10
Consume 1,000 gold coins: Elf Swordmaster (Epic)*1, Crystal Gift Pack*3, Pet Snack*2
Consume 2,000 gold coins: Elf Guardian (Epic)*1, Fire Opal*1, Pet Snack*4
Consume 5,000 gold coins: Healing Saddle (7 days)*1, Fire Opal*2, Crystal Gift Pack*5
Consume 10,000 gold coins: Pure Blade Aida (Legendary)*1, Solar Chest (Legendary)*1, Silver*1,000,000
Consume 30,000 gold coins: Fire Ruby*2, Solar Chest (Legendary)*2, Silver*3,000,000
Consume 50,000 gold coins: Black Opal*1, Solar Chest (Legendary)*2, Silver*5,000,000[/u]
[b]9.Pack (Limited Time Event) - Booster Bonanza[/b]
[u]15 packs of King’s Pack - Fire Ruby*1 / Lunar Chest (Epic)*1 / Silver*500,000
10 packs of Master’s Skill Pack II - Super Void Gift Pack*2 / Silver*500,000
30 packs of Specialist Pack II - Cancer (Legendary)*1/ Silver*1,000,000
15 packs of Cryptic Human Pack - Legendary Box*1 / Unicorn Tempest (7 days)*1
10 packs of Elite Pack - Class Selection Crystal*1 / Silver*100,000[/u]
[b]10.Master of Blacksmith
11.Master of Alchemy
12.Special Offer Shop[/b]

See the pictures for details. The event content is subject to the game content. The official has the final right of interpretation.

notes.title: Trial Dungeon - series is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players:

<火焰征程> will add a new trial dungeon to the game in the [b]update on May 20th[/b] - the <禁典回廊> series. Players can obtain rich pet skill upgrade secrets, secret book fragments, trial store exchange coins and other rewards through the [b]<禁典回廊>[/b] dungeon. These rewards will help you greatly improve the combat effectiveness of your pet's skills in the future!

The first version of the trial dungeon is [b]禁典回廊 1~5[/b]. The level required to enter the dungeon and the difficulty of the dungeon are different. Of course, the higher difficulty of the dungeon, the richer reward. After the player reaches the specified level, he can increase the number of challenge dungeons by consuming tickets or gold coins (300 gold coins); after the player passes the dungeon, he can flip the card.

Below is some important information you need to know in advance so that you can understand the new copy more quickly.

[b]Dungeon type: Trial
Dungeon name: 禁典回廊 (1~5)
Opening level: Lv30/35/40/45/50
Is a ticket required: Yes (obtained through purchase, event)
Important drops: Store exchange coins -符文页、灵纹石、魔法徽章 (Trial store will be available in subsequent versions)
Random pet skill books - a certain number of pet skill upgrade secrets or fragments can be obtained randomly (pet skills will be available in subsequent versions)[/b]

notes.title: ​《火焰征程》: Alchemy Synthesis System Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,​​

The tides of war and deck-building strategies are about to undergo a revolutionary overhaul! The [b]Alchemy Lab Synthesize System[/b] is coming soon, shattering faction boundaries to forge mysterious hybrid creatures! Below is an exclusive preview—unlock the core information now!

[b][u](This announcement previews a development build; final rules are subject to in-game implementation.)[/u][/b]

[b]Key Features​​​[/b]

[b][Unit Evolution]​​[/b]
Sacrifice surplus troop cards to fuse [b]8 new hybrid factions[/b]: Holy Crusaders, Legion Warriors, Enlightened Invokers. Unleash battlefield lineups with infinite strategic permutations.

[b][Free Unlock]​[/b]
The Alchemy Lab’s Synthesis function auto-unlocks when reaching Player [b]Level 30[/b].

[b][Dual Resource Costs][/b]
To synthesize common/good/rare/epic cards: Consume "[b]Fusion Catalyst[/b]"; To fuse legendary/godlike cards: Consume "Advanced Fusion Catalyst" (Fusion Catalyst can be obtained in the Tower shop~)

[b]Alchemical Protocol​​[/b]

[b]Step 1: Card Placement​​​[/b]
Tap the right-side Card Vault to place your Primary Card; the left slot locks automatically. (Switch cards via double-tap)

[b]Step 2: Faction Resonance​​[/b]
Select faction filters in the bottom panel; the vault dynamically displays compatible faction cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/bd9f15417eb52bf1e7a7b997c5a300986fb01a58.png[/img]

[b]Step 3: Outcome Simulation​​[/b]
With both cards set, activate the "Preview" button! Strategically adjust combinations using real-time genetic forecasts.

[b]Step 4: Catalyst Arbitration​​​[/b]
System auto-checks catalyst reserves:
Sufficient materials: The "Synthesize Start" button is highlighted, and a new card will be created after confirmation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/efe44134e9a042ecd2ea8bef5b1c409bfa4f9525.png[/img]

[b]Notes​​
⚠️ New Synthesis creatures cannot be upgraded via Enhance methods. Strengthen them only in the Alchemy Lab’s [Combine] Interface using same-tier Synthesis cards.[/b]

Thank you for your unwavering support of 《火焰征程》. The alchemical runes are etched, and destiny’s arsenal awaits your command—will you rewrite the Chronicle of War?​

notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview — Pet Skill is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players:

Following pet reborn and absorption, the pet system is about to usher in another major update: [b]the opening of pet skills[/b]. The opening of new pet skills is aimed at enhancing the value of pet training and its combat effectiveness, making pets a more powerful assistant on your adventure journey! The following is a preview of the features for you:

[b][u](The following is a display of the test server experience content, the final online version shall prevail)[/u][/b]

[b][Unlock Pet Skill Column][/b]
When the pet level reaches Lv4/Lv6/Lv8, 3 additional columns of the skill talent column can be unlocked respectively. When at least 1 additional column is unlocked, the "Skill comprehend" operation can be done. If no additional column is unlocked, the "Skill comprehend" operation cannot be done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/f9d985b641f537bf494746dc5b275d45128147b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/ce7b4af9e3ce80ac33934b8aec751c963ae10f4c.png[/img]

[b][Skills to Learn & Upgrade][/b]
In the "Pet/Pet Skills" interface, players can view the skills that can be comprehended/upgraded for the selected pet; the number of skills that can be comprehended for pets of different qualities is also different. The first version is tentatively open to the learning of skills for pets below epic quality:

[b]Ordinary  → up to 4 skills to comprehend
Excellent  → up to 9 skills to comprehend
Rare  → up to 16 skills to comprehend[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/fae188836084ac76a8e12c752884a99b98849e15.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/fce02c841a563616eac5591fa105e30a64ef3b5e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/95275d5eae6933f5e28bad69f426397f0c2f2384.png[/img]

[b]It should be pointed out here that the skills of pets of the same quality will be obtained randomly from the skill library, and there is a certain probability of obtaining rare skills. [/b]For example, two identical black wind wolves may have different skills to learn. The rich skill library adds more fun to your pet exploration and development.

After selecting a pet, click "Comprehend" on the pet skill interface to consume a certain amount of gold coins, and you can randomly obtain a skill from the pet's skill pool and randomly add it to a skill column (if the skill column is already filled with skills, you can choose to replace the position.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/9c1df5ae55d70c7c1e34b0ee5d2fe6f85d75528c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/5fb8d80571c5de27eaa37a2c6ce31392490f0790.png[/img]

[b]Select a pet to view the skill status in the pet's skill pool. The skill icon has two states: highlighted and grayed out. Grayed out means unlearned skills, and highlighted means learned skills. Players can consume a certain number of designated props to upgrade learned skills. Higher-level skills will bring more powerful effects. We will also gradually open up the output and drop of upgrade props in subsequent gameplay and activities.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/7669de8033d0fbc91d8daa40664c2f7137f3c2e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/62fc784946aee9a7d41997647fd1137509f29a1e.png[/img]

New changes brought by the opening of pet skills
☆ Improve the value of cultivation: As the pet level increases, more pet skills are brought;
☆ Improve pet potential: A rich skill library brings more possibilities for improving pet potential;
☆ More skill experience: More new skills add more fun to adventure battles;

The opening of pet skills is a major change that will bring a further leap in the combat effectiveness of pets. At the same time, the rich pet skills also bring unlimited possibilities for pet training. Please pay attention to the subsequent announcements on our official platform for more update details and launch time.

notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview — Pet Island is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

The brand-new [b][Pet Island][/b] is about to arrive! This mysterious island is filled with rare resources and untold challenges, awaiting all tamers to explore. Below are the key details to know its core mechanics!

[b]​​[Highlights at a Glance]​​[/b]
Unlock Requirements: Reach Level ≥20 and unlock the Pet System, then access Pet Island via the World Teleportation Portal!
​​Solo PVE Adventure: Freely explore a shared multiplayer map with independent resource nodes—no competition, just peaceful gathering!
​​Strategy Meets Surprise: Trigger random events—either claim treasures instantly or battle powerful monsters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b568955a5dd88ba88b2ab56c0be8f1ab0b051b81.png[/img]

[b][Core Gameplay in 3 Steps]​[/b]
[b]​​①Click to Collect Random Encounters[/b]
Monsters will spawn randomly across Pet Island. Tap them to start gathering!
Two outcomes may occur:
​​Instant Rewards: Collect materials without combat!
​​Enter Combat: Defeat the monster to claim rare resources!
[b]②Treasure Trove of Resources – Three Key Resources Guaranteed from Gathering[/b]
Basic Resources (Guaranteed Drops)​​
Silver: Universal currency for enhancing equipment and enchanting cards.
​​Pet Food Fragments: Synthesize a specific number to craft exclusive pet food and unlock pet skills.
​​Pet Essence: Redeem various rewards in the Pet Island Store to swiftly cultivate your pets.
[b]​​③Daily Attempts, Flexible Planning​​[/b]
Default daily attempts: 5. Once exhausted:
​​Wait for Reset: Free attempts refresh daily!
​​Expand with Gold: Spend gold to instantly increase attempts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/c46b7c3322d1e180bc15c86e0364bf3ba3453f0c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/e476764aea30351dbae48ca737c6b606302bd8ab.png[/img]

[b]​​[Optimization Details]​​[/b]
Seamless Map Experience: All players are displayed on the same screen for lively immersion, but resources are calculated individually—pure solo adventure!
​​Visual Status Updates:
​​Countdown Timer: Visible when attempts remain. Nodes reset to grayed-out positions after use. Locked Nodes: Fully consumed attempts lock nodes until daily refresh!
​​Interaction Priority: Overlapping players trigger collection first—no more accidental misclicks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/82a5f21e71d0df6ee2b54e3cc40401e36d06fe91.png[/img]

Pet Island is designed as an immersive growth space for all players, blending casual play and thrilling challenges. Whether you’re a casual collector or a combat enthusiast, there’s something for everyone! Future updates will introduce exchange shops and crossover events to enrich your experience.
Stay tuned to our official platforms for release dates and more details. See you on the island!

——《火焰征程》Operations Team

[u](Note: This preview reflects a work-in-progress version. Final rules are subject to in-game implementation.)[/u]

notes.title: Warehouse Feature Preview – 火焰征程
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Today we’re bringing you an early look at the upcoming [b]Warehouse feature[/b] coming soon to 火焰征程!

[u][b][Please note: The following content is based on the development version from the test server. The final version is subject to change upon official release.][/b][/u]

[b]The Warehouse system is designed to provide players with a more convenient way to store and manage their items. A Warehouse NPC will be available in the world scene — simply visit them to open the Warehouse interface. From there, players will be able to deposit and withdraw items, as well as organize their inventory quickly and efficiently.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b97ff5ed0da451c37d2a926c327d012a89050205.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/eb9552d638f1989f4d69e7756b5e1ebfc79d2531.png[/img]

[b]Every player will have their own default warehouse with a set number of slots. You’ll be able to manage your storage strategically and even expand your warehouse capacity using gold, depending on your needs.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b83bd5c2eb182ac3b482877a72d6af9069441c6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/8f3b2344901e2074c54a095c3d75c5e394a59ccd.png[/img]

That’s all for today’s sneak peek! Stay tuned to our official channels for more details and the release date of this exciting new feature.

Thank you for your continued support and love for 火焰征程! We hope you’ll discover even more exciting content and enjoy an enhanced gameplay experience in the upcoming update.

notes.title: Special Offer Shop Now Open Once a Month: Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and love for the game. In order to better balance the in-game economy and enhance the player experience, we have carefully considered and decided to adjust the opening frequency of the Special Offer Shop starting next month.

[b]The specific changes are as follows:
- Original plan: Open once a week
- Now adjusted to: Open once a month[/b]

We believe this adjustment will create a healthier in-game economic environment and give every player more time to plan their resources and game progress effectively.

The purpose of this change is to:
1. Provide more strategic thinking opportunities, making each opening of the Special Offer Shop a special event worth anticipating.
2. Better regulate in-game resources and spending, avoiding the imbalance caused by too frequent Special Offers.
3. Better cater to the needs of various players, especially those with limited resources and time.

[u][b]Additionally, please note that the Discount Shop on April 8th will be the last one for April![/b][/u]

We understand that this change may affect some players, but we believe it is an important step for the long-term development of the game. We will continue to monitor your feedback to ensure that each opening of the Special Offer Shop provides the best gaming experience.

Once again, thank you for your support and understanding! The final interpretation rights belong to the [i]火焰征程 [/i]team!

notes.title: 火焰征程 - Server Merge & Cross-Server Adjustment Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

To enhance gaming experience, 火焰征程 will manage server merge and cross-server adjustments during the maintenance period scheduled for April 8, 2025, from 10:00 to 14:00 (UTC+8). 
Please be aware of the maintenance time to avoid unnecessary losses. The actual server reopening time may be earlier or later than scheduled depending on progress. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Below are the details—please spread the word!

[b]①Server Merge Details[/b]

[b]S1~4 will merge with S5, with S1 as the main server.[/b]
[b]S6 will merge with S7, with S6 as the main server.[/b]

[u]Note: After the merge, all original login and character data will remain unaffected. Players can log in using their usual server selection.[/u]

[b]Merge Compensation: Festival Pack*5, Ticket Gift Pack*1, Fire Opal*1, Silver*200,000, Change Name Card*1
Compensation Eligibility: S1、S2、S3、S4、S5，S6，S7[/b]

[b]②Cross-Server Adjustment[/b]

[b]After the maintenance, S10 will be included in cross-server battles with S6~7,S8,S9. Players on these servers can now team up, challenge dungeons, compete in the arena, and participate in cross-server rankings.[/b]

[b]Cross-Server Compensation: Mythos Pack*2, Silver*100,000
Compensation Eligibility: S6、S7、S8、S9、S10[/b]

[b]③Important Reminders[/b]

[u]To avoid unnecessary losses, players on merged servers are advised to suspend all auction house transactions before maintenance. This includes listing items for sale, bidding, and ongoing transactions.[/u]

*The final interpretation rights of this event belong to the official 火焰征程 team.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Themed Fashion Preview Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Valentine's Day is approaching, and we’ve prepared special [b]Valentine’s Day-themed fashion and mount[/b] to bring you a double dose of sweetness and magic!

Fashion: [b]Beloved Sweetheart[/b]
With its sweet pink tones and romantic design, this fashion set will make you the bright star this Valentine’s Day!

Mount: [b]Magical Spirit Cat[/b]
This mount is full of fantasy and magic, galloping alongside you in battle and adding a touch of wonder to your adventures!

Preview Note:  
[b][u]We’ve provided reference images for the fashion and mount, but please note that the actual in-game appearance may differ slightly. Stay tuned for the final version once it goes live![/u][/b]

Release Time:  
[b]After the February 11th update, the fashion and mount will be available through limited-time events.  [/b]
Stay tuned for more details in future announcements!

notes.title: 火焰征程: Announcement on Punishments for Exploiting Item Duplication Bug
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

To maintain a fair and just gaming environment, we are committed to providing an enjoyable experience for all. Recently, we discovered that some players maliciously exploited a game bug to duplicate items, severely disrupting the balance of the game and the experience of other players. We take this matter very seriously and have implemented the following measures:

[b]1. Bug Fix[/b]
The bug has now been fully resolved, and the issue will not recur. We appreciate the community's attention and support for fair gameplay.

[b]2. Punishment Measures for Involved Players[/b]
In accordance with the relevant provisions of Chapter 4 of the Steam Subscriber Agreement, "Online conduct, cheating and illegal behavior," after a thorough investigation of the data, we have decided to apply different levels of bans to players who have exploited vulnerabilities for improper gains. Additionally, we reserve the right to recover all unfair benefits obtained through such actions.
[b]7 accounts with lighter offenses have been banned for 7 days.
44 accounts with more serious offenses have been banned for 60 days.[/b]
We hereby declare that we will strictly enforce game environment regulations to protect the rights and interests of the majority of players. We urge players to take good care of their accounts, refrain from lending accounts, avoid using third-party cheat programs, and never exploit bugs for unfair benefits.

If you have any questions about the above, please contact us via official email at huoyanzhengcheng@gmail.com. We will respond to all inquiries. Thank you for your support.

[b]Steam Subscriber Agreement:
https://store.steampowered.com/subscriber_agreement/[/b]
Please note: The above-mentioned punishments took effect immediately upon the release of this announcement, and the relevant players have been processed.

[b]3. Commitment to Fair Play[/b]
We are committed to upholding a fair gaming environment and will not tolerate any behavior that disrupts game balance. Moving forward, we will continue to enhance bug detection and prevention to ensure the healthy development of the game.

[b]4. Encouraging Player Reports[/b]
We encourage all players to actively report any violations within the game. Successful reports will be rewarded, with specific reward details to be announced in future communications.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
We hope all players will cherish the gaming environment and enjoy a fair and fun experience. If you have any questions about this announcement, please contact us through our official customer service channels.

Best regards,
Operations Team of 火焰征程

notes.title: Preview of Weapon Special Effects Update for
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

In order to enhance the gameplay experience and visual effects, we will be conducting a comprehensive update of the weapon special effects in the near future. This update will add more dazzling and expressive special effects to various weapons, not only enhancing the visual impact of combat but also providing players with a more immersive and diverse sense of hitting power.

Update Details:

[b]1.Weapon Attack Special Effects Overhaul[/b]
We have reworked the attack special effects for several weapons. The new effects are more refined, delivering a stronger visual impact. Every strike has been carefully crafted, allowing players to feel the power and strength of their weapons more clearly in battle.

notes.title: Pet System 2.0 Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are pleased to announce that [i][b]火焰征程[/b][/i] is about to enter a new chapter - "[b]Pet System 2.0[/b]" is about to debut! In this update, we have brought two revolutionary new gameplays: [b]Pet Absorb and Pet Reborn[/b]. Aims to enhance your pet training experience and make your pet a more effective partner on your adventure.

⭐ [b]Pet Absorb: More Efficient Resource Utilization[/b]⭐

[b]Experience Transfer: Players can transfer the experience of other pets in your team to the target pet. This innovative feature will help you use resources more effectively, avoid duplication of work when training low-level pets, and greatly improve the efficiency of pet training.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/c5606ae388ec9c193786ef77c9135ed43f0c2b26.png[/img]

[b]The upgrade progress of the sacrificed pet will also be absorbed, and will disappear after absorption. Different quality pets contribute different experience to the target pet when they are selected for absorption. The higher the quality, the more experience they contribute.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/d5260b7ecc739d1132dec4c89c9994aa3ad70f86.png[/img]

[b]The target pet's information will also show the growth value, level, and status changes after absorbing the pet, which can help players quickly understand the pet's improvement.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/7cecc72fc8c170cd17370f963e0597695f1eefc0.png[/img]

⭐[b]Pet Reborn: A Leap in Quality and Ability[/b]⭐

[b]Pet Reborn: Use your extra pets as sacrifices and offer them to a pet to give it a chance to transform. The target pet will transform into a new pet of higher quality, with more powerful status and new pet skills, making your battle strategy more diverse.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b1e9826010ef0ecbd862d589a3f431bab3bf9d0d.png[/img]

[b]The quality of the sacrifice pet will affect the success rate of reborn. The higher the quality of the sacrifice pet, the greater the contribution to the success rate. At the same time, the quality of the sacrifice pet can only be equal to or lower than the target pet by 1 quality. Players can choose multiple sacrifice pets to offer success rate of reincarnation.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/22a86a5f51b8c0f5bcfe8363b7b278bcac7174db.png[/img]

[b]The reincarnated pet will become a new pet of higher quality, with more powerful talents and new pet skills, but will not inherit the pet skill level of the original pet. There is a certain chance of failure in reborn, and the sacrifice pet will be consumed when it fails, but at the same time it will permanently increase the success rate of the next reborn.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/1d5f9cd2a6c4a3fa85f9636d23c38c26d42c4dc1.png[/img]

⭐ [b]Changes brought by Pet System 2.0[/b] ⭐

[b]Improved training efficiency[/b]: With the pet absorb function, you can train powerful pets faster without repeatedly investing time and energy.
[b]Pet quality upgrade[/b]: The pet reborn function gives your pet the opportunity to obtain higher quality and become an indispensable force in your adventure.
[b]New skill experience[/b]: The reincarnated pet will bring new skills to add more possibilities to your battle.

We know that every adventurer hopes that their pet can be a strong backing on the journey. The launch of Pet System 2.0 is to respond to this expectation and make your pet training journey more exciting.

Please stay tuned, more details about Pet System 2.0 and the launch date will be revealed one after another. We look forward to welcoming this exciting new journey with you!

The screenshots and content above are from the test server version. The final version will be based on the official release. All rights of interpretation are reserved by the [i][b]火焰征程[/b][/i] team.

notes.title: “火焰征程” Fashion Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

  We are thrilled to announce that[i][b] 火焰征程[/b][/i] is about to bring you a major and highly anticipated update—[b]the Fashion System[/b]!
  [b]The Fashion System is designed to offer players a wide range of character appearance customization options. With fashion, your character can have a cool and unique style, featuring various themed outfits including holiday, tech, fantasy, and more![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/4f4c2b321ddd1d55a121f2fa05c91d0b7ce2cfb0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/91217bed54f33deea8f4497c6ff8d6c7397a3b55.gif[/img]
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
 [b]Fashion items come with both time-limited and permanent durations. Once obtained, they can be equipped from the "Character" tab in your backpack. Fashion items are categorized into five tiers based on quality: Exquisite, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Unprecedented. Players can obtain fashion items of various quality levels through different channels. The higher the fashion tier, the richer the special effects and higher the attributes. Fashion items can also be linked with your equipped mount, adding unique features to your beloved steed.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/990b967cbc844996fda781f316628a2c00e1399c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/a9ac0ce6ef6a8a4ca35ed94e64d26be12a20f99c.gif[/img]
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
[b]What’s even more exciting is that fashion comes with attribute bonuses, boosting stats such as health, block, and critical strike, helping you dominate the battlefield. Experience a whole new style of combat today![/b]

notes.title: Halloween-themed Event is Coming
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that on [b]October 29, 2024, Beijing time[/b], a brand new Halloween special dungeon and events will be updated in the game!
[b]Servers: S1-S10[/b]

[b]Event 1:[/b]

Halloween Dungeon: [b]Halloween Cave[/b]
Dungeon Feature: On the night of Halloween, mysterious magic power enveloped the entire continent. The evil pumpkin lord awakened from his slumber and led his ghost army to wreak havoc everywhere. Brave heroes must step into this dungeon full of horror and challenges, defeat the pumpkin lord, and restore world peace.
There are [b]first-pass rewards and clearance rewards for the "Fastest Challenge of Halloween."[/b]
Unlock Conditions: [b]Level 30[/b]
Opening Time: [b]00:00 on October 29, 2024 - 00:00 on November 5, 2024 (Beijing time)[/b]

Halloween Exchange: [b]Halloween Carnival Exchange[/b]
Exchange Feature: To celebrate Halloween, there will be a limited-time Halloween carnival exchange event from 00:00 on October 29, 2024, to 0:00 on November 5, Beijing time!
Exchange Method: In the game, players can obtain "[b]Candy[/b]," "[b]Pumpkin Lantern[/b]," "[b]Witch's Hat[/b]," and "[b]Wacky Mask[/b]" by completing various tasks, participating in event dungeons, defeating monsters, etc. Players can save the characters they have obtained in the character collection backpack. When a certain number of characters are collected, they can exchange for corresponding rewards.

[b]Event 3:[/b]

To celebrate Halloween, we have prepared a special gift code for this holiday.

[b]Gift Code: ws[/b]

[b]Candy*1
Pumpkin Lantern*1

notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The World Scene, which was mentioned in the August version revelation of [b]《火焰征程》[/b], will be available to all players [b]on October 15, 2024 after the update[/b]! As a brand new game scene, the main purpose of [World Scene] is to strengthen the communication between players and show their style, and we are going to learn more about the details and the update plan from Q4 2024 to Q4 2025.

Warm tips: The following are all test servers or art effect displays. The final effect is subject to the official online version. The[b]《火焰征程》[/b]team has the final right of interpretation.

[b]1. Update of [World Scene][/b]

[b]Players can enter or leave the world scene by clicking the [World][Inner City] button in the main city scene of the game.[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/3d020f79034c19b999fc6e1dd9521a02b569ee48.gif[/img]

[b]In addition, players who enter the scene can walk around freely. If the player is carrying a pet, the pet will also follow.[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/0969d036aac34e7465ca6f44c790e92c8dd28bf8.gif[/img]

[b]In the world scene, players' chat messages will not only be displayed in the chat box, but also on the avatars of the characters in the scene with the effect of chat message bubbles.[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/be4688adaea825f4890b4d5c3d4029faa0cc2dbf.gif[/img]

As the first version of the world scene, the design and development team will try to improve the players' experience as much as possible under the premise of ensuring stability. We will also gradually enrich the supporting functions of the world scene in the subsequent version updates to further enhance the player experience.

[b]2.More Updates Preview[/b]

We expect to launch more updates and optimizations aimed at improving the fun and experience of the game from the end of 2024 to 2025. The following is the planning of some content.

[b]【Q4, 2024】[/b]
[b]①**Pet System**[/b]
Open pet reborn & new skill talents. The opening of new functions is to make pets more growth-oriented and avoid the waste of training resources. At the same time, new skills will also make your favorite pets more powerful.
[b]②**World Scene Honor Display**[/b]
Players with special honors will get a special display position in the world scene to show their status.

[b]【Q1-Q2, 2025】[/b]
[b]①**Mount System**[/b]
The new mount system will not only be limited to battles, but will also show other players your cool mounts in more scenes including the world.
[b]②**Title System**[/b]
Players can obtain titles and show their unique charm in different scene.
[b]③**Fashion System**[/b]
Different fashion combinations will be reflected in the game, especially in the world scene, it will no longer be a stereotyped "professional outfit".

[b]【Q3-Q4, 2025】[/b]
[b]①**Pet Island**
②**Resource Battle**[/b]

[b]【Ongoing】[/b]
[b]**Art Quality Iteration**[/b]

In addition, we will continue to iterate and optimize the art quality. Whether it's the game scenes or the character models of the cards, we will continue to optimize this aspect.

We have not done it perfectly along the way, but we will always keep a player-first heart and continue to enrich and optimize the game content. We also welcome players to give feedback and communicate on our plans. Thank you for your support along the way.

notes.title: National Day-themed Event is Coming
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that on [b]October 1, 2024, Beijing Time(UTC+8)[/b], a brand new National Day special dungeon and events will be updated in the game!

[b]Covered Servers: S1-S9[/b]

[b]Event1:[/b]

[b]National Day Dungeon: [i]Lucky Journey[/i][/b]
[b]Dungeon Features: [/b]In this dungeon, players will embark on a journey to sunny beaches. Waves crash on the shore, and mysterious treasures are hidden in the sand. Players must avoid sudden attacks from seagulls, defeat monsters disguised in sandcastles, and explore the mysterious ruins at the end of the coast to earn precious rewards and unique items.
There are first-pass rewards and clearance rewards for the "[b][i]Fastest Challenge of National Day.[/i][/b]"
[b]Unlock Conditions: [i]Level 30[/i][/b]
[b]Opening Time: 0:00 on October 1, 2024 - 0:00 on October 8, 2024 (Beijing Time)[/b]

[b]Event2:[/b]

[b]National Day Legend Return Store[/b]
To celebrate the National Day, the game will launch the [b]Legend Returns Store & Legend Exchange Event[/b] for a limited time [b]from 0:00 on October 1st to 0:00 on October 8th, 2024, Beijing Time[/b]! notes.title: Announcement on the launch of the pet system and new novice function
notes.notes:
Dear players:

We are pleased to announce that the new pet system and new novice features of "火焰征程" will be officially launched on [b]September 3, 2024[/b]!

[b]New novice functions:[/b]

The optimized novice guidance system will help new players get started with the game more quickly and fully understand the game mechanics and gameplay.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/65b00141c79fd8143becc810296df75b957242fa.png[/img]

[b]New pet system:[/b]

[b]· Open level: [/b]The pet system is opened when the hero level reaches level 20.
[b]· Exclusive entrance: [/b]Players can enter the pet system through the "Pet" entrance in the main city interface.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/4cf5bc2c2bc0e2ab3061442c6f0107c42833742e.png[/img]

[b]· Basic functions[/b]
[b]Synthesis: [/b]Synthesize pets by using a specified number of pet fragments.
[b]Feeding:[/b] Feed pets with food items to increase their levels. Higher levels can increase the pet's basic attack power, talent level, and unlock skills.
[b]Talents:[/b] Different talents will bring different combat bonuses.
[b]Skills: [/b]Pets have their own exclusive skills to play a role in battle. (Open later)

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/5d70b8daa022b6b7df1da3612f14e1e5436f0f63.png[/img]

The following is the display effect of some pets and talent skills in the test server. The final content is subject to the online version. All rights of interpretation belong to "火焰征程" Team.

Pet name: Sea Frilled Lizard
Skill and Talent: Beast Roar

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/820504950231dc13f4fc65359e7f2081a405782e.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/d4ed9d5d9d53a0b97ffca8433771e74ac1c378fb.png[/img]

Pet name: Hairy-Toothed Pig
Skill and Talent: Feral

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/a67f5e65a8a82e50756130d5b6fffe967c1bfe02.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/6011c693c9d7aa879531c39e759a364c30ea8f95.png[/img]

Pet name: Black Wind Wolf
Skill and Talent: Rampage 1

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/37f70b454c35f078e14a4535f6562e1998cc2eaf.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/74974efa9ed282a7c66cf399251b72586242621f.png[/img]

[b]· Collaborative battle: [/b]Pets will participate in the battle, providing additional support and skill effects for your battle, making you more handy in the challenge.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/d9b82161c87334c8b9cacb49f1abf681621034ee.png[/img]

[b]· Other functions: [/b]Pet fragments and food fragments obtained from dungeons or activities are transferred from the original personal backpack to the pet's exclusive backpack, freeing up space in the personal backpack so that players can better manage other items.

Thank you for your continued support and love for "火焰征程". In the future, Pet Reborn, Pet Skills and other functions will be opened one after another. We look forward to exploring new content with you and meeting more challenges!

notes.title: "火焰征程" version update revelation
notes.notes:
Dear players,
We are very happy to announce that "火焰征程" will bring you a series of exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. The following are the main contents of the new features:
1. [b]New version of novice guide[/b]
[b]Monologue Episode[/b] A new monologue will be added to the new guide, centered around the protagonist investigating the mysterious disappearance of an explorer during his quest. This episode will reveal more of the backstory and mission objectives, making the start of your game even more intriguing.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/dec7442ec554d4168bd8131d0f409668d03663e2.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/c9efa23544f9aae72d740507d72bf5481a5903ef.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/1efe3fb7d1bb4b7b536a05da72af4d1fb852a654.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/77c970c413e2881f584fb9baab9d4e1f30ddad59.png[/img]

[b]Icon guidance and character movement function[/b] In order to help players better explore the game world, we have introduced icon guidance and character movement functions to make the game scenes more vivid and real. With the movement of the game characters, you can not only see the dynamic movement of the characters in various scenes, but this function will also provide players with clear navigation guidance, so that you can find mission objectives and important scenes more easily.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/284ed27894c0ab46aa672826c91d9913b4fa987e.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/65b00141c79fd8143becc810296df75b957242fa.png[/img]

2. [b]New “World” entrance in the main city interface[/b]
[b]World function display[/b] The newly added "World" entrance will become an important window for you to understand the game world. "World" not only includes the original character movement function in the novice tutorial, but also allows you to see the explorers' waiting screen in the main city and the display scene of the top three explorers' glory moments.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/6fa5a774f9e1df9be15e8d9b6129d89eff90f1b3.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/f8a3d501e370168f2b94fe4d84231483a8d933dc.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/3823e50703edc8927fb7f99e0bd458d795c8e750.png[/img]

3. [b]Open pet system[/b]
[b]Pets fight side by side with players[/b] We have opened a new pet system. Each pet has unique skills and talents, which can provide players with additional attribute bonuses, such as attack, block, life, etc. In battle, pets will assist players in attacking enemies, reduce the pressure of your battle, and become a powerful partner on your adventure.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/5a8c8a653173e8d676951d6b299b70e889055f23.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/c0c259baf8b40097594b861bdb0bedbb0a4a5698.png[/img]

We believe that these new features will bring you a richer gaming experience and fun. Stay tuned to our official platform for more details on the update and when it will be available.
Thank you for your continuous support and love for “火焰征程”! We look forward to seeing you in the new version to discover more exciting content and enjoy a brand new gaming experience.

notes.title: Announcement of Game Special Card Customization on "火焰征程"
notes.notes:
Dear "火焰征程" Game Players,

Thanks for your support and love for our game! To reciprocate the kindness of our players and provide a unique gaming experience for our esteemed VIP12 players, we have specially launched a [b]VIP12 Special Card Customization Service[/b]!

[b][Customization Content][/b]

1.**Style Customization**: Players can collaborate with our art team to create a one-of-a-kind card art style based on their preferences.

2. **Skill Customization**: Players can propose their ideal skill concepts and work with our game-planning team to craft exclusive and powerful skills.

[b][Customization Rules][/b]

1. This service is exclusively for players who have reached VIP12 status through recharge.

2. The customization of special cards will be carried out in the order of players reaching VIP12 status. Players who reach VIP12 first will receive priority for customization services.

3. During the customization process, please communicate and negotiate with our official team to ensure that the final product meets the expectations of both parties.

4. Once customization is complete, the special cards will serve as an exclusive benefit for VIP12 players and cannot be transferred, sold, or traded in any other way.

[b][Application Process][/b]

1. Players who have reached VIP12 through recharge should contact us via official email to submit a customization request.

2. We will contact you within 5 working days after receiving your application to begin the customization process.

3. During customization, please communicate with our team and provide timely feedback and confirmation on the progress.

4.Upon completion of customization, we will distribute the cards in-game and notify you via email.

[b]PS: Players can join the official discord and send a private message to Operations Personnel to apply for customization.

Official Discord Link: https://discord.gg/y4Q4PfGGgg[/b]

Thank you for your support and understanding! We look forward to providing a one-of-a-kind card experience for every VIP12 player! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us. Enjoy the game!

Best regards,

"火焰征程" Game Development Team

notes.title: Updates On Game Rules
notes.notes:
Rules of Score Boosting:
Score Boosting is against the rules, and if we find you are cheating, the following rules will apply:
For the first violation, your score will be reset to zero; for the second violation, your score will be reset to zero and you will receive a 3-day ban; for the third violation, you will be permanently banned.
This does not apply to trade wins, but we will take action if a player takes a favor from their substitute or another player in a 1v1 or 2v2.

Rules of League Score Boosting:
It is against the rules to create new accounts to claim league tickets and facilitate yourself or others in a closed league. If such behavior is discovered, we will take necessary action.

Use Tools Like Apps And Auto-Clickers:
It is against the rules to use auto-clickers or other programs and scripts to complete a match instead of doing it yourself. This is an unfair gaming practice because you can use tools in your free time to complete tasks and gain experience and items that you wouldn't otherwise be able to earn. If such behavior is discovered, we will take necessary action.

Harass Other Players:
If a player asks you not to message them privately and you continue to do so, it constitutes harassment. Please also refrain from using slurs and hate speech in public chat, as this is a form of behavior that damages the gaming environment. If such behavior is discovered, we will take necessary action.

Abuse of Program Error:
Intentional abuse of programming errors is against the rules. If you find a bug in the game, please contact customer service via email for feedback.

notes.title: 关于进一步严厉打击游戏作弊行为的通知
notes.notes:
尊敬的玩家们：

您好！

为了维护游戏的公平性和良好的游戏环境，我们一直在努力打击任何形式的作弊行为，包括但不限于竞技场与竞技赛作弊行为。

近期，我们发现部分玩家通过不正当手段进行刷分、刷票与倒卖货币等行为，严重破坏了游戏的平衡性和其他玩家的游戏体验。为了维护游戏的公平性和健康发展，我们决定采取以下措施：

1. 对于发现存在刷分行为的玩家，我们将对其积分进行清零处理。
2. 对于发现存在刷票行为的玩家，我们将对其不正当手段获取的收益清零处理。
3. 对于发现存在其他作弊行为的玩家，我们将对其通过其他不正当手段获取的道具、货币与其他收益移除处理。
4. 对于多次违规或情节严重的玩家，我们将进行部分限制或封号处理。

打击游戏作弊行为从本公告发布起生效。同时，因异常导致被惩处的账号，经过严格核实后，我们将收回处理并予以补偿。

我们希望广大玩家能够自觉遵守游戏规则，共同维护一个公平、健康、和谐的游戏环境。同时，我们也欢迎玩家举报任何形式的作弊行为，我们将对举报信息进行严格保密，并及时处理。

感谢您的理解和支持！

notes.title: Important Announcement: Crackdown on Game Score Manipulation
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Greetings!

To uphold the fairness and maintain a positive gaming environment, we consistently strive to combat all forms of cheating, including but not limited to score manipulation.

Recently, we have observed that some players are unfairly manipulating their scores through unauthorized means, severely disrupting the game's balance and diminishing the experience for other players. In response to this, we have decided to implement the following measures:

1. Players found guilty of score manipulation will have their scores reset to zero.
2.For players who have repeatedly violated rules or committed serious offenses, we will impose account suspension measures

We expect all players to adhere to the game rules and contribute to a fair, healthy, and harmonious gaming environment. Additionally, we encourage players to report any instances of cheating, and we assure you that all reports will be handled with strict confidentiality and prompt action.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Announcement on Fair Gameplay and Competition
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We deeply understand that fairness and competitiveness are crucial for safeguarding the interests of our players and enhancing their gaming experience. To ensure that every player can enjoy fair competition within our game, we hereby issue the following announcement:

**I. Strict Measures Against Malicious Score Boosting**

Malicious score boosting, which includes but is not limited to exploiting game vulnerabilities, using external cheats or hacks, employing boosting services, or any other unethical means to gain high scores or victories, severely undermines game balance and the spirit of competition. We will take a zero-tolerance approach to such behavior and impose severe penalties upon verification.

**II. Enhanced Supervision and Punitive Measures**

To effectively combat malicious score boosting, we will implement the following measures:

1. Strengthen Game Supervision: Through a combination of technical means and manual patrols, we will conduct real-time monitoring and prompt handling of any unusual activity within the game.
2. Improve Game Rules: We will continue to optimize game rules, reduce vulnerabilities, and enhance the fairness and competitiveness of the game.
3. Bolster Game Security: We will reinforce the protective measures of our game servers to prevent the infiltration of malicious programs such as cheats and hacks.
4. Implement Punitive Measures: For verified cases of malicious score boosting, we will impose penalties such as account bans, chat restrictions, and score deductions, depending on the severity of the offense.

**III. Promoting the Spirit of Fair Competition**

We urge all players to consciously abide by game rules and uphold the spirit of fair competition. Together, let us create a healthy and harmonious gaming environment. Please refrain from participating in any form of malicious score boosting to make our gaming world a better place.

**IV. Reporting and Feedback Mechanism**

If you encounter any player engaged in malicious score boosting or other violations within the game, please promptly report them to the game's official channels. We will carefully investigate each report and take appropriate action in accordance with our policies. Additionally, we welcome your valuable suggestions and feedback to help us continually improve and optimize the game.

Finally, we would like to express our gratitude to all players for your support and enthusiasm for our game. Let's work together to create a fair, just, and enjoyable gaming world!

Game Operations Team
